description: This file contains unit tests for the PrometheusBasedResourceLimitChecks class, verifying its behavior in checking resource limits like connections and data volume using mocked web requests and a cache, with test cases covering various scenarios of limit enforcement and calculation logic.

classes.name: PrometheusBasedResourceLimitChecksTest
classes.description: Unit test class for PrometheusBasedResourceLimitChecks, testing various resource limit scenarios with mocked HTTP requests and cache interactions.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by mocking HTTP requests, WebClient, cache, and configuring the object under test.

methods.name: testConnectionLimitIsNotReached
methods.description: Tests that the connection limit check returns false when current connections are below the maximum.

methods.name: testConnectionLimitIsReached
methods.description: Tests that the connection limit check returns true when current connections meet the maximum.

methods.name: testMessageLimitNotExceeded
methods.description: Verifies that message data volume check returns false when usage is within limits.

methods.name: testMessageLimitExceeded
methods.description: Verifies that message data volume check returns true when usage exceeds limit.

methods.name: testCalculateDataVolume
methods.description: Validates the data volume calculation logic for different periods and usage scenarios.

methods.name: testCalculateDataUsagePeriod
methods.description: Verifies correct calculation of data usage periods based on timestamps and period modes.

methods.name: testMessageLimitNotExceededWhenNotConfigured
methods.description: Ensures that when no data volume limit is configured, the message limit check returns false without querying metrics.

methods.name: testMessageLimitUsesValueFromCache
methods.description: Ensures that the data volume usage value is fetched from cache when available.

methods.name: testMessageLimitStoresValueToCache
methods.description: Verifies that upon fetching metrics data, the cache is updated with the latest usage.

methods.name: givenCurrentConnections
methods.description: Helper to mock a response with current connection count from the prometheus endpoint.

methods.name: givenDataVolumeUsageInBytes
methods.description: Helper to mock a response with current data volume in bytes from prometheus.

methods.name: createPrometheusResponse
methods.description: Creates a mocked JSON response mimicking Prometheus vector result for testing.
